headline: Ministry of Development: Working group to determine the average interest rate increase on consumer credit
summary: The Ministry of Development will form a working group to draft a joint ministerial decision setting the percentage increase in the average effective annual interest rate on consumer credit.
why: Consumer credit rate ceilings and adjustments affect household borrowing costs and lending volumes in Greece's banking sector.
